intervention: Pair fixed global single-axis TLS and observed-support-axis readers on each complete immutable base and original saved candidate inside the identical original RGB mask. No refit, patch rewrite, camera replacement, retuning or new sampling policy.
repeat_policy: Two fresh reader-only subprocesses. The exact same original one-per-object DA3 predictions and eight patches are reused. This is not an independent end-to-end reconstruction repeat.
evaluation_policy: All prior object development scores have been seen; this is not blind. Inference still forbids truth/score access. Require all 80 normal rows and every frozen point/patch receipt before this run accesses object truth. Score common outputs and ten unchanged native added-curve arms separately; preserve every rejection, empty output and error.
qualification: Previously scored synthetic development assemblies, not blind data, real capture or external assets. Reader retains unique actual points and selects axes by observed axial support rather than voxel means or raw point counts. Fixed local-task readout, not semantic identity or whole-object topology. No reader qualification or G1 promotion; preserve baseline, naive controls, failures, timing and storage.
